subject: Legal: evidence bundle & sync for contract redlines
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novushealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: ContractOps <contracts@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contract redlines + evidence pack — scheduling

Hi Jordan + Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — procurement and legal at Novus want to move forward but need a quick redline walk-through and a packaged set of security/compliance evidence before our internal review. Broad asks from our side: SOC 2 (redacted OK), overview of data retention/backups, SAML/SSO details, and a copy of the proposed redlines so legal can note any exceptions.

Can we schedule a 45-minute session this week to run through the redline file and the evidence bundle? Available windows in our timezone (EST):
- Wednesday 6/16: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Thursday 6/17: 09:30–10:15 or 14:00–15:00

If you can’t make those, share two alternatives and we’ll try to match. Also — do you have a preferred process for redline comments (DocuSign vs. tracked Word)? We usually prefer a tracked Word so legal can markup.

Attached: procurement checklist template (procurement_request_template.xlsx).

Regards,
Elaine Park
Head of Vendor Strategy — Novus Health
elaine.park@novushealth.com
[Attachment: procurement_request_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract redlines + evidence pack — scheduling

Thanks Elaine — we can definitely do this. Proposed approach:
1) 45-minute sync to walk through proposed_redlines.docx and note any immediate concerns (tracked changes preferred).
2) Share a short evidence bundle (SOC2 redacted, architecture summary, SAML config excerpt, data retention table) ahead of the call.
3) Follow-up: share an editable tracker (we’ll host the most recent redline doc in Drive and export a Word with tracked changes).

From Redwood: I’ll attach the initial evidence bundle v1 (redwood_evidence_pack_v1.zip) and SOC2 redacted. Markus will cover SSO/SCIM details during the call.

For the meeting windows in your timezone, we can do Wednesday 6/16 15:00–15:45 EST — that works best for our CE and legal. If that’s okay, I’ll send an invite. If you prefer earlier, we can do Thursday 6/17 09:30–10:15 EST as a backup.

Quick Q: who should receive the final DocuSign envelope? If Novus prefers tracked Word first, we’ll iterate there.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.ai]
[Attachments: redwood_evidence_pack_v1.zip, SOC2_report_redacted.pdf, proposed_redlines.docx]
